The weekly AI agent and skills directory update · November 15, 2026
Eight businesses to start today. The tools are here. Build something people need.
This week's Suede AI Rising Skills brings you the breakout repos, the skills pulling serious install numbers, and eight concrete ways to turn them into a business. Pick a problem. Build the workflow. Put an offer in front of a customer.
Building with Claude Code, Codex or Cursor? This is your starting lineup. Every pick links straight to the project or its Suede assessment. Less hunting. More building.
This edition in 60 seconds
Seven breakout repositories: private agent workspaces, live maps of agent activity, animated websites, video production and content repurposing.
Security is surging: Cloudflare's security-audit-skill leads the recorded weekly star gains, while security-auditing skills show the strongest topic growth in the saved install data.
Vercel and HeyGen dominate the top five recorded weekly skill installs.
8 businesses to start today: from GEO audits and lead qualification to landing-page sprints and short-form video production.
Five A-grade picks: skills for partnerships, app-store optimization, security analysis and storytelling.
Seven breakout repos. Seven ways to build something better.
Seven picks from our weekly breakout watch: projects created between November 8 and November 15, ordered by recorded GitHub stars in our November 15 snapshot.
1. agentes-chat · 1,414 stars
agentes-chat/agentes-chat
A self-hosted workspace where people and AI agents share channels and direct messages. Bring the work into one shared conversation instead of scattering it across individual agent sessions.
Build with it: set up a private agent workspace for a team. Package the onboarding and maintenance around it. Sell the working setup, not another tool they have to figure out.
2. lot-map · 840 stars
alexeyw/lot-map
A live visual map of Claude Code's activity, including tool calls, hooks, skills and subagents.
Put it to work: make multi-agent workflows visible. Show clients what ran, trace what happened and debug the workflow without burying everyone in a wall of logs.
3. line-art-animation · 778 stars
JDhruv14/line-art-animation
A Claude skill for animated line-art scenes and characters.
Build with it: put an animated explanation of the product right on its landing page. Show the thing working. Give the visitor something better than another generic AI hero image.
4. ste80-humanizer · 621 stars
Dodaios/ste80-humanizer
A writing skill aimed at removing familiar AI-writing patterns and producing clearer technical English.
Put it to work: clean up the AI-assisted drafts piling up across your agency. Cut the stock phrasing, sharpen the technical writing and keep the facts and the writer's voice intact.
5. cinematic-skill · 421 stars
Moh4696/cinematic-skill
Code-driven narrated films that coordinate camera movement, images, maps and cards with a voice track.
Build with it: product explainers, research summaries and launch videos with visuals that actually explain the idea. Make the camera, maps and narration work together.
6. guizang-game-skill · 343 stars
op7418/guizang-game-skill
A skill for building playable 3D browser action games, with generated assets and a single-HTML-file delivery format.
Build with it: branded mini-games for launches, events and campaigns. Give people something to play with instead of another form to fill out.
7. article2media · 316 stars
threerocks/article2media
Repurposes an article or transcript into formats including carousels, magazine-style graphics, WeChat layouts and voiced short videos.
Build with it: a recurring content service that turns one strong source piece into a full set of platform-ready assets. Adapt the idea to each format. Stop copying the same paragraph everywhere.
The big repos are moving too
The recorded weekly GitHub star gains:
Cloudflare security-audit-skill: +6,750
Matt Pocock's skills: +6,689
Anthropic skills: +5,780
Impeccable: +4,634
Vercel agent-browser: +4,317
Security. Development workflows. Design. Browser execution. That is where these star gains are landing. Take the capabilities behind the numbers and put them into something your customers can use.
What builders are installing right now
The top five skills in the final recorded week of the November 15 skills.sh snapshot:
find-skills — 110,096 recorded weekly installs; Suede score 81 · B
media-use — 104,156 recorded weekly installs; Suede score 80 · B
agent-browser — 103,297 recorded weekly installs; Suede score 75 · C
hyperframes-cli — 103,285 recorded weekly installs; Suede score 77 · C
hyperframes — 103,215 recorded weekly installs; Suede score 80 · B
Over 100,000 recorded weekly installs for every skill in this top five. We put the Suede score right beside the install count so you can see both the traction and the assessment before choosing your stack.
Popular and highly graded are not the same thing. Agent-browser recorded 103,297 weekly installs and carries a 75 · C in our assessment snapshot. CodeQL carries a 92 · A. They do different jobs; choose for the task, then check the assessment. An install count tells you what people are trying, not whether it fits your workflow.
Explore the full leaderboard →
Security installs jumped 168%. Here is the growth.
Comparing the latest recorded install week with the preceding week:
Security auditing and review: +168%, reaching 105,927 weekly installs.
Browser agents and computer use: +19%, reaching 103,828.
PDF workflows: +4%, reaching 4,309.
Security takes the lead by a mile in this snapshot. Building software for clients? Make pre-release review part of the work: find the issue, investigate it and give the developer a clear next step.
8 businesses to start today!
You have the tools. Now give them a job worth paying for. Here are eight offers to build, package and put in front of customers.
Choose your starting point with four questions: Who needs the result? Which tools cover the job? What still needs your judgment? Who will buy it? Start with the offer you can demonstrate and deliver best.
1. Launch a GEO and AI-visibility audit service
Find what stops AI search from understanding a business. Turn the findings into a prioritized fix list the owner can act on. Start with seo-audit and schema.
The offer: an audit, a prioritized action plan and clearer website information for search engines and AI agents. Give the owner the next steps, not a pile of jargon.
2. Build a lead-qualification service
Turn inbound enquiries into useful sales briefs: what the prospect needs, whether they're a fit and what the next action should be. Start with revops.
The offer: turn a messy inbox into a sales-ready brief for each lead. Needs, fit, next action. Get the team out of sorting mode and into useful conversations.
3. Take repetitive finance admin off the team
Pick one job: transaction categorization, document collection or preparing exceptions for review. Build that workflow and make it repeatable.
The offer: organized records and an exception queue ready for review. Nail one recurring task first. That is a service you can explain, demonstrate and deliver.
4. Turn support chaos into a service
Organize incoming tickets by issue and urgency, prepare relevant context and draft the next response.
The offer: a prioritized queue with context and draft responses ready to review. Give the support team a head start on every ticket.
5. Package pre-launch security reviews
Build a pre-launch review service around fp-check and CodeQL, with an experienced reviewer evaluating the findings.
The offer: a clear findings report with specific investigation and fix priorities. Make it useful to the developer who has to act on it.
6. Start a short-form video production service
Build a repeatable production workflow with Hyperframes for product explainers, announcements and educational clips.
The offer: a recurring video series built around the client's products and expertise. Consistent visuals. Specific ideas. A recognizable style across the whole series.
7. Sell better prospect research and outreach
Combine prospect research with cold-email to prepare specific, relevant outreach.
The offer: researched prospects and outreach that speaks to their actual business. Show why the fit makes sense. Give the recipient a reason to care.
8. Launch a landing-page sprint offer
Pair Impeccable with CRO for focused landing-page work.
The offer: one focused landing page with a clear offer and a working conversion path. Define the audience and the action. Build the page around both. Ship it.
Explore Suede AI Agent Studio →
Pick your stack. Give it a real job.
SEO + GEO: seo-audit → schema. Find the website's problems, then structure its information more clearly.
Lead operations: revops + cold-email. Organize prospect information and prepare outreach around a specific offer.
Landing pages: Impeccable + CRO. Pair the design work with a clear audience, offer and conversion path.
Security review: CodeQL → fp-check → Trailmark finding triage. Analyze the code, check findings and investigate reachability with a reviewer.
Video production: Hyperframes + plot structure. Shape the story and build the visual sequence around it.
These are task stacks to assemble around your workflow. Pick one, run a sample and judge the output against the job.
Five A-grade skills to put to work
Co-marketing · 90: plan partnerships and joint campaigns.
ASO · 90: work on App Store and Google Play listing optimization.
CodeQL · 92: analyze code for security vulnerabilities.
Trailmark finding triage · 91: investigate a security finding with reachability context.
Plot structure · 90: develop story arcs, pacing and structure.
Stop collecting repos. Start building.
Browse by topic, compare top skills, explore stacks or use the directory finder from your own agent.
Try asking it: “Find skills for the work I actually do: GEO, sales, video and website design. Show me the strongest options and explain why.”
Pick one of the eight businesses. Build a sample. Show a potential customer what it does. That is your next move, not another hundred saved repositories.
At Suede AI, this connects directly to our SEO, GEO and AI development work: make a business easier to find, make its offer easier to understand and build the systems that turn interest into action. The skills are useful when they move that work forward.
Built something worth including? Submit it to Suede AI →
Find your next stack at SuedeAI.directory. If the directory helps you build, give the repo a star on GitHub.
Subscribe to Rising Skills for the next weekly update.
Jason Colapietro Founder, Suede AI
*Edition data: November 15, 2026. Installation rankings use the last recorded week in the saved skills.sh history. Quality scores use the directory's dated assessment snapshot. Repository star figures use the saved GitHub snapshots. Read the scoring methodology.*
Read this edition on Substack or Medium. Originally published on Suede AI.
